name: analyze_media
description: Analyze a media file (video, audio, or image) with Gemini. Ask questions, extract structured data, describe content. out keeps the raw reply; meta reports token usage.

input.description: Video, audio, or image file to analyze

output.description: Model response (plain text or JSON if --json-output)

params.name: json-output
params.description: Request structured JSON output from the model

params.name: out
params.description: Write the raw reply (code fences kept) to a file instead of stdout

params.name: max-output-tokens
params.description: Cap on reply tokens, thinking tokens included

params.name: thinking-budget
params.description: Cap on thinking tokens (0 turns thinking off where the model allows it)

params.name: fps
params.description: Video sampling rate in frames per second

params.name: media-resolution
params.description: Tokens spent per frame or image

params.name: meta
params.description: Print one JSON object: text (or path with out), usage, model, finishReason, parseError
